tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The warm cream everything sits on; never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, quiet sections, code blocks and the score-bar track. Sits on ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, choice cards and inputs sitting on surface or ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on ground, surface and raised. Decorative only (1.3:1): a border that must be seen, such as an input's focus state, switches to ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground, surface, raised, butter and blush (16.4:1 on ground light, 16.1:1 dark). Plum ink replaces black everywhere; also the 2px border on buttons and selected choice cards.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Helper text, captions, meta and inactive tabs on ground, surface and raised (6.6:1 light, 9.4:1 dark). Also the normal score-bar fill.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and the active-tab underline. A maple orange, deepened to sit with autumn photography. One tangerine action per screen. Fill only: never carries text on a light ground (3.4:1).

tokens.name: tangerine-text
tokens.usage: Tangerine when it carries words: links, quiet buttons and small labels on ground, surface and raised (5.5:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-tangerine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tangerine fill (4.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark). Never white on tangerine.

tokens.name: sunshine
tokens.usage: Highlights, demand-generation pillar tags, the focus of attention. Fill only.

tokens.name: on-sunshine
tokens.usage: Text on a sunshine fill (10.4:1 light, 11.9:1 dark). Never white on sunshine.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Warm callout panels, conversion pillar tags and the selected choice card fill. Carries ink.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Margin notes, the diagnosed break point in a score bar, loyalty moments. As text or stroke on ground, surface and raised (5.9:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Not for buttons.

tokens.name: on-berry
tokens.usage: Text on a berry fill (6.1:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft community and testimonial panels, loyalty pillar tags. Carries ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and open status, as text or a status dot on ground (4.9:1 light, 10.1:1 dark). Always paired with a word; success and error differ by hue only, so colour never carries the meaning alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Scarcity and caution (seats left), as text or a status dot on ground (5.6:1 light, 9.7:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors that need a fix: the message text and the input border, on ground and raised (6.4:1 light, 8.0:1 dark). The message says what to do next.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every surface (5.9:1 on ground light, 7.7:1 dark). Same value as berry.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Docs sidebar and dark chrome. Carries sidebar-ink.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar (14.8:1 light, 17.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on sidebar (8.7:1 light, 10.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The sticker offset shadow colour. Only ever a hard offset, never a blur.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: You're not failing. You just can't see what's broken yet.
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. 40px on mobile.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers and offer titles. 34px on mobile.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Start here. Ignore the rest for now.
styles.usage: Card titles and sub-headings. 20px on mobile.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: She's smart, she's capable, and she's tired of working hard in the wrong direction.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Clarity doesn't remove the work. It removes the panic.
styles.usage: Everything people read. 17px on mobile. Measure capped at 68ch.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, form hints, stepper labels, meta.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags and the smallest labels. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin notes only, in berry, 24px or larger. Never for anything a reader must read to complete a task. 24px on mobile.

spacing.note: 4px base. Section rhythm is space-9 between page sections on desktop and space-8 on mobile.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag vertical padding; quiet-button horizontal padding; underline offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Quiet-button vertical padding; gap between a status dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input vertical padding; tag horizontal padding; score-bar height.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; choice-card vertical padding; mobile gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Offer-card padding; desktop gutters; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading inside a long page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Nothing yet; reserved.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Quiet buttons and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, choice cards and offer cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Screens and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and score bars.

shadow.note: The brand separates things with lines and colour shifts, not soft grey shadows. The only shadows are hard offsets in the shadow colour, like a sticker lifting off the page.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover (with a -2px,-2px translate) and the selected choice card.

tokens.name: sticker-lg
tokens.usage: The featured offer card. One per screen.
